limits: 80m is the existing regional engineering coefficient; final forest/terrain occlusion is not accepted.
Exact full-army local reports/formation/hold/contact start require current observation of all three units. Uncertain reports and remote per-unit formation UI remain future work.
Legacy observation-free saves remain explicitly labelled technical display until a versioned observation action or next request opts in. No past observations are invented.

Only the stated29 GPU checks were rerun: two new knowledge cases, representative repeat/renewal/cancel result/moving cancellation/evidence/deadline/withdrawal/held recovery, legacy military/combat, ground material and three smokes. Other older cases were not rerun in this slice.
Observation history storage and nationwide load are not accepted by these local trials.
18second fixed60fps recording contains actual movement and chronological saved-state cuts; it is not a realtime performance benchmark.

visual_review.method: Viewed eight fresh post-fix Godot screenshots and five decoded video frames. Confirmed ground remains visible at wide overview, dated memory/report labels stay inside viewport, unseen troops/cargo/couriers are not shown at true remote positions, re-observed troops become current, and actual personal withdrawal is independent. Assembled-camp label overlap and final terrain occlusion/HUD quality are outside this stage acceptance. Fixed60fps capture is not a realtime performance benchmark.
